MEMORANDUM

Subject: Network of Sicilian and Italian-American criminals moving heroin, money and favors across state lines.
A nationwide crime syndicate did exist.

SUBJECT: BARBARA, JOSEPH
BORN: 1905, CASTELLAMMARE DEL GOLFO

ARRESTS: MORE THAN ONE
NAMED IN: SERIOUS INVESTIGATIONS
CONVICTIONS: NOTHING STUCK

Why would a Brooklyn gangster be leaving
a soft drink distributor's house?

Found in Costello's pocket:

A slip of paper.
Handwritten figures.

Later traced to the earnings of a new Las Vegas casino.
